estimation_metadata.demand: User-selected primary modeling assumption: estimated demand on every retained flight equals 1.20 times its directional route's historical monthly carried passengers per performed departure. The 20% uplift is assumed, not estimated from observed unmet demand. Raw passenger observations are unchanged.
estimation_metadata.same_route_limitation: Flights on the same directional route retain the same estimated average demand; this assumption does not estimate time-of-day peaks.
